premises.text: Disjointed paper processes and human measurement errors drive massive material waste on job sites
premises.evidence_span: simple human errors result in almost 20% of materials on a given job site being completely wasted

premises.text: Platform must be usable by every worker, not only supervisors or project managers
premises.evidence_span: every worker on the job site can use the equipment

premises.text: Rock app connects measurement capture to calculators and common plan-to-build actions
premises.evidence_span: measurement capture, automatic putting into calculators, utilities, and other common actions

premises.text: Digital tape auto-syncs readings; saw-mounted caliper and QR labels remove guessing and Sharpie steps
premises.evidence_span: takes any guessing out of what measurement I'm interpreting

premises.text: Recon uniquely spans day-to-day capture and execution versus incremental tools or narrow enterprise apps
premises.evidence_span: Recon Tools is the only system that has the granularity needed

value.text: Streamline jobsite measurement and cut costly avoidable errors

secondary_value.text: Stop treating overruns and delays as inevitable
secondary_value.evidence_span: stop expecting errors, cost overruns, and timeline delays as inevitable

causal_links.evidence_span: over $100 billion wasted in construction each year
streamline the process and takes out what I normally have to hang you off a ladder
execute day-to-day operations on the job site

notes: Bio/MIT shop story excluded. Synonym goals (digital tape as common as drill) treated as aspiration not premises.
